features.name: grid based labyrinth
features.notes: About 31 by 31 cells; large maze layout.

features.name: dark gray walls
features.notes: Roughly 10 studs tall and 2 studs thick.

features.name: light gray floor plane
features.notes: Single continuous plane underneath the entire maze.
features.quote: Include a floor plane underneath the entire maze

features.name: green start tile
features.notes: Set into maze floor on one outer edge.

features.name: red end tile
features.notes: Set into maze floor on the opposite outer edge from start.

features.name: solvable maze routes
features.notes: Continuous navigable path connecting start and finish.
features.quote: a proper solvable path from start to finish
